title: Green Apple Sorbet
changes_from_base: Raw Granny Smith apples puréed with lemon and icing sugar replace the mango; no cooked syrup and no corn syrup.
summary: Crisp, tart and pale green-white: raw Granny Smith apples puréed with lemon and icing sugar and churned straight away.

steps.title: Lemon first
steps.text: Put the lemon juice in the food processor bowl before you cut anything.

steps.title: Cut
steps.text: Peel and core one apple at a time, slice it thinly straight into the bowl and toss with the juice so it does not brown. Purée: add the icing sugar and cold water and process, scraping down twice, until completely smooth, 2-3 min.

steps.title: Churn at once
steps.text: Churn straight away for 20-25 min while the purée is still pale.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Pack into the container and freeze for 2 h. Serve with thin slices of fresh apple.

tips: Work quickly once the apples are cut; the lemon juice stops them browning.
Granny Smith apples give the best sharp flavour.
Serve between courses as a palate cleanser.
storage: Keep covered in the freezer for up to 1 week; sorbet turns icy after that. Soften for 10 min before scooping.
